method: Private XDG/catalog/D-Bus; real CPAL output with master0 before play, local main mpv --ao=null. One logical core=100%. Eight-second default samples; same16 wet layers for coverage0/50/100. No live plugin/settings changes. Short smoke, not an audible-quality or long-soak guarantee.

cycles.note: Each cycle starts, pauses, removes the last source, re-adds while paused, resumes and stops. 100 ms snapshots intentionally capture rapid reuse; final snapshot waits for the output to close and asserts baseline FDs/threads.
